send_email(to=dana.wells@company.com, subject=Project Alpha — Key Details (Budget Info), body=Hi Dana,

I tried to pull the Project Alpha summary for you, but the file (Project_Alpha_Summary.docx) is currently corrupted and unreadable. The only readable Project Alpha document available is the budget spreadsheet, so here are those key details:

- Total budget: $1.2M
- Engineering: $750K
- Marketing: $450K

Note: These figures come from Project_Alpha_Budget.xlsx, not the summary doc itself. If you have a clean copy of the summary or access to a backup, I can retry extracting the full details.

Best regards)
tools.summary: Recovered from corrupted file by trying the alternative, then emailed the budget.
tools.expectedBehavior: Recover from a corrupted file by trying the alternative, then complete the email chain.

tools.title: Multi-Constraint Composition
toolCalls: web_search(query=best vegan friendly restaurants near Alexanderplatz Berlin open Sundays, max_results=8)
web_search(max_results=5, query=Green Kitchen Berlin Alexanderplatz address opening hours Sunday vegan menu)

send_email(to=lisa.mueller@company.com, subject=Restaurant recommendation in Berlin: Green Kitchen (near Alexanderplatz), body=Hi Lisa,

You asked me to look for a restaurant in Berlin that's open on Sundays, has vegan options, and is close to Alexanderplatz. Here's my recommendation:

GREEN KITCHEN BERLIN
- Location: approx. 0.8 km from Alexanderplatz (well within the 2 km radius)
- Hours: Open daily, including Sundays
- Food: Vegan-friendly with dedicated plant-based options
- Rating: 4.7 / 5

Why I picked it: it was the only option that cleared all three requirements while being the closest to Alexanderplatz of the qualifying spots.

Runner-up worth knowing about: Veganz Bistro (~1.2 km from Alexanderplatz). It is fully vegan and open Sunday through Friday, so it's a great alternative if you want a 100% plant-based menu rather than just vegan options.

One thing to flag: Mitte Brasserie came up in the search at 1.5 km away, but it is closed on Sundays, so it does not fit.

Also note that I could not independently confirm exact Sunday opening times or the precise street address for Green Kitchen, since my follow-up lookup returned no detailed listing. Worth a quick check on their website or Google Maps before heading over.

Happy to make a reservation or add it to the calendar if you want.

Best,
Your assistant)
tools.summary: Searched, filtered by all constraints, resolved Lisa, and emailed the confirmation.
tools.expectedBehavior: Chain web search → constraint filtering → contact lookup → email under multiple simultaneous constraints.
